items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: But there was a fellow, too, by the name of Esque Douglas, who worked with the band.

ctx.x: and I don't care for the ROTC in the first place. And I don't care to march and I know nothing at all about the bass." He said, "Mr. Thomas, you'll have to cooperate." I said, "I am the best of cooperating, Mr. President, to/my knowledge." He said, "What did you do?" I said, "I stayed at home. Stayed in my dormitory." He said, "That won't do at all." And I said, "Well, why, Mr. President?" He said, "Because we're bringing in ROTC here for a trial period and we want it to go." I said, "Is it my curriculum?" He…
But there was a fellow, too, by the name of Esque Douglas, who worked with the band.
